scope: Personal-agent long-project implementation on the current workspace mainline

implemented.project_and_phase_manifest: Root goal and user acceptance criteria; appendable phase directory in the existing private project_tasks.db, with keyset pagination and exact session/instance ownership
implemented.bounded_execution: Each phase reuses the existing 1–6-analysis task DAG and explicit per-run approval; no second executor, autonomous planner or automatic paid resumption
implemented.phase_capacity: Valid project phases do not consume standalone 20/session and 100/worker task counts; all state remains bounded by the existing 64 MiB task-store quota
implemented.replan: Add/retire steps and change dependencies via exact revision plus preview SHA-256; old/new downstream closure invalidates affected artifacts, preserves unrelated completed branches and permanently retires old step IDs
implemented.criteria_delivery: Project and phase acceptance conditions are present in the actual task context, within the unchanged whole-context budget
implemented.predecessor_handoff: At most six combined local and explicitly selected external parent steps share the existing 2000-byte whole-unit handoff; source and selected-note scope cannot silently expand
implemented.truthful_delivery: Saved parent references are not called delivered until completed task receipts exist; exported reports disclose actual phase counts and exact parent step/report versions
implemented.parent_answer_lineage: Derived analyses bind actual parent answer IDs and exact task/step/artifact versions; source withdrawal, note revision or selected parent-plan change withdraws child reports, history and confirmed notes
implemented.standalone_task_lineage: Ordinary same-task predecessors also carry exact task origins, not only long-project phases
implemented.safe_layout_binding: Production worker-root and direct-data layouts are explicitly bound and checked; no filesystem search, owned-directory fallback or relocation of existing research data
implemented.history_batch: A request-local memo is no longer mistaken for the 128-entry per-memory-packet bound; document and mixed-memory 160-answer chains remain visible in 100-answer batches until actual withdrawal
implemented.performance: Queue/set ancestor traversal, one task read snapshot and one research read snapshot, request-local deduplication and shared lineage memo; no cross-request freshness cache
implemented.fail_closed: Inspection byte/time budgets, exact version checks, malformed metadata guards and unresolved-provider-outcome reconciliation are preserved; no hidden model retry
implemented.ui: Existing chat now exposes long projects, phase review and linked task plans; replan preview shows affected and preserved branches before separate confirmation
implemented.ci: New long-project, lineage, storage-layout, personal-event, publication and replan regressions are listed in Product contracts

regressions_found_and_fixed: A selected parent-plan edit invalidated its child report while leaving derived chat history and confirmed memory usable
A shared 128-entry memo cap incorrectly hid 32 of the last 100 answers in a valid 160-answer chain
Standalone local task handoffs omitted exact parent task-version origins
Refs-only internal service arguments could be silently dropped by the legacy answer shortcut
Corrupt falsey non-list task origins were treated as an empty valid scope
Real production worker storage differs from native test fixture storage, causing resumed predecessor-dependent work to fail before dispatch
preserved: Existing logo, demo, overall visual style and README were not edited by this increment
Harness, Insight Schema and configured multi-model adapters remain the execution path
No new model call for state changes, dependency checks, report composition, plan previews or user reviews
Full prompt ceiling 24576 UTF-8 bytes, task context ceiling 8192 bytes and predecessor handoff ceiling 2000 bytes are unchanged
not_claimed: Traceable ancestry does not prove semantic entailment, a correct causal chain, complete evidence retrieval or a useful customer deliverable
Event relations remain explicit source-bound assertions, not automatic verified causal discovery
No new Step 5 or other paid-model quality/token/latency A/B measurement was performed in this increment
No unlimited storage: document catalogue still has 20/session and 100/worker limits; memory-packet and recursion bounds remain
Ancestor checks remain O(V+E); repeated full checks during N successive append operations can still total O(N^2)
No autonomous external action, automatically approved replan, unattended cross-week paid work or complete RSI
No public deployment, GitHub push, signed phone installer or physical-device acceptance in this increment
